name: Water and Wastewater Cybersecurity (EPA checklist on CISA CPG 2.0)
description: EPA's Cybersecurity Checklist for Drinking Water and Wastewater Systems (WCAT 3.1, 33 questions, 16 EPA priority practices) answered Yes / In progress / No / Not applicable, each question mapped to the CISA CPG 2.0 goal that owns its control and evidence task. Includes a Cybersecurity Risk Management Plan and a Cyber Incident Response Plan structured after the AWWA 2025 templates, and interview questions from the CISA water-sector tabletop exercise package. Sources are public domain (EPA, CISA); crosswalk by BomberJacket Networks.
